_comment: Events. Add upcoming events to 'upcoming' and move them to 'past' once they have happened. 'date' must be YYYY-MM-DD. 'endDate' is optional. 'registerUrl' is optional — leave it as an empty string to hide the Register button. The page sorts by date automatically and will move an event out of 'upcoming' on screen once the date passes, so you don't have to do it the same day.
